Class SolutionView

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.ig.SolutionView
public final class SolutionView extends Object
The views of the solutions, claferIG's SolutionView.hs: a static model has instances, and a dynamic model has traces, whose states are instances. Both are sequences of snapshots, which the full view shows one by one, and the diff view shows as the changes from the previous snapshot.

    • showSolutionDiff

      public static String showSolutionDiff(UnaryOperator<String> names, int n, Solution previous, Solution solution)
      The diff view of the n-th solution. The first state of a trace, whose clafers all appear (+), is shown in full, and each next state as its changes: the clafers that appear (+), with their children, and that disappear (-), and the values that change (~), each at its depth in the tree and with its least-partially-qualified name, given by the UID of its clafer. The states are compared by instance, which has the same name in every state. An instance is compared with the previous instance, if any, by its structure, since the names of the instances of separate solutions are unrelated.
      Parameters:
      previous - the previous solution, or null
